name: process.list
description: Enumerate running processes. Returns pid, image name, parent pid, and basic resource counters per entry. Read-only.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against the image name (e.g. `notepad` matches `Notepad.exe`). Omit to list all processes.

image.description: Executable name (filename without path), e.g. `Notepad.exe`. Empty string for kernel-internal processes the agent can't query.

ppid.description: Parent process id. May be 0 or refer to a no-longer-running process if the parent has exited.

x-implementations.name: create_toolhelp32_snapshot
x-implementations.description: Win32 `CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS)` + `Process32FirstW` / `Process32NextW` walk. Each PROCESSENTRY32W carries th32ProcessID, th32ParentProcessID, and szExeFile.

x-implementations.name: enum_processes
x-implementations.description: Win32 `EnumProcesses` + `OpenProcess` + `GetModuleBaseNameW` per pid. More verbose, sometimes catches edge cases Toolhelp misses.

windows-modern.description: CreateToolhelp32Snapshot is the primary path; falls back to EnumProcesses + GetModuleBaseName when Toolhelp fails (rare). Filter applied client-side after enumeration. Per-process reads of image name may fail with ERR permission_denied for protected processes (anti-cheat / antivirus); those entries report `image: ""`.

windows-classic.description: CreateToolhelp32Snapshot on NT 5+ and Win 9x (kernel32 export). NT 4 lacks Toolhelp in kernel32; the agent loads PSAPI.DLL and uses EnumProcesses on NT 4. Otherwise behaviour matches modern.
